This is the first full release, after four public betas.

- **Pre-race checklist overlay** for SimHub: circuit and exact layout, car model, class, number and team, race duration, fuel, tyre wear, time scale and start time, each marked ✓ match, ✗ mismatch, – any, ☐ check or ○ unknown.
- **Every layout is checked.** All 38 layouts on LMU's 18 tracks are mapped to Factory Seat's layout names and confirmed in LMU's track picker.
- **To do hints** in LMU's own wording for every mismatch, such as "Set Tyre Wear to X3", including LMU's "Default ( 11:00 AM )" start time.
- **Custom team rounds can be READY TO RACE.** Team and Car number show Any, and Custom team identity shows Not checkable, since LMU can't report a Race Control custom team.
- **Shows only in LMU's menus.** It stays hidden until LMU's menus appear, hides while loading or driving, and has a SimHub action to toggle it.
- **Windows installer and zip**: no building from source, no settings files to edit. Updating keeps your settings and saved overlay layouts.
- Reads Factory Seat's `briefing.json` round briefing (Factory Seat 1.1 or later).
